blockers.quote: When someone close beats you at something central to who you are, the closer they are, the sharper it cuts (c06).
blockers.why: The verbatim quote for c06 supports that outperformance by a close other on a task high in self-relevance poses a 'greater the threat to self-evaluation', not affective or physical cutting/pain ('the sharper it cuts', which conflates with c05's fMRI pain finding).
blockers.fix: When someone close beats you at something central to who you are, the closer they are, the greater the threat to how you see yourself (c06).
